en: I need to ask you a silly question.
zh: 我必须问你一个蠢问题。

en: Tom freed the bird.
zh: Tom將鳥放走。

en: Ouch! My finger got caught in the door.
zh: 好痛！被门夹到手指了！

en: I have to go to the toilet.
zh: 我要上厕所。

en: I bought two pairs of pants.
zh: 我买了两条裤子。

en: This is the cutest puppy I've ever seen.
zh: 這是我見過最可愛的小狗。

en: She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.
zh: 她锻炼时扭伤了脚踝。

en: We had to stay home because of the storm.
zh: 因為暴風雨的關係，所以我們必須待在家裡。

en: The bride seems to be very pretty.
zh: 新娘好像非常漂亮。

en: I'm sorry to bother you so often.
zh: 一直打扰你不好意思。

en: My mother boiled ten eggs.
zh: 妈妈煮了十只蛋。

en: There are no people who don't desire peace.
zh: 沒人不渴望和平。

en: I lost the watch my father had given me.
zh: 我把爸爸給我的錶弄丟了。

en: She had my mother take care of the baby.
zh: 她让我母亲照顾孩子。

en: She has a lot of respect for her teacher.
zh: 她非常尊敬她的老师。

en: She knows a lot about the latest fashions.
zh: 她很了解最新的時尚趨勢。

en: He's the manager of the marketing department.
zh: 他是营销部的负责人。

en: He and I were inseparable friends during our time together in school.
zh: 我和他在學生時代是分不開的朋友。

en: You can probably guess what happens though.
zh: 但你很可能猜得到会发生什么。

en: When I heard that song, it reminded me of my childhood.
zh: 我一聽到那首歌，就想起來我小的時候。

en: Those kinds of methods are out of date.
zh: 这种方法早已过时了。

en: That kind of person will definitely fail.
zh: 这种人注定惨败。

en: That kind of person will fail for sure.
zh: 这种人注定惨败。

en: What is the total amount of money you spent?
zh: 你一共花了多少钱？

en: Do I have to answer all of the questions?
zh: 我需要回答所有問題嗎？

en: It looks like your dog is thirsty.
zh: 你的狗看起来口渴了。

en: This car was so cheap that he could afford it.
zh: 這車便宜得讓他能買得起。

en: I have to go to the bathroom.
zh: 我要去廁所。

en: I can't follow his logic.
zh: 我无法理解他的逻辑。

en: All you can do is trust one another.
zh: 你们除了信任对方，没什么要做的了。

en: Do you know how many people in the world starve to death every year?
zh: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人饿死呀？

en: I was very moved by her kindness.
zh: 我深深地被她的仁慈所感動。

en: He wrote a book about a jungle adventure.
zh: 他写了一本关于丛林冒险的书。

en: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
zh: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。

en: She took a bite of the apple.
zh: 她咬了一口蘋果。

en: Say hi to your father for me.
zh: 代我向你父親問好。

en: Can I use your dictionary for a minute?
zh: 我能用一下你的字典吗？

en: As long as good people do nothing, evil will triumph.
zh: 只要好人袖手旁观，恶人就会得胜。

en: Do you want to eat noodles or rice?
zh: 你吃面条还是吃饭？

en: Usually I cycle or get the bus to work.
zh: 我通常骑自行车或乘公交车去上班。

en: What's the daily fee?
zh: 每天费用多少？

en: My father participated in a cooking contest and came in first.
zh: 我爸爸参加了料理竞赛并得了第一名。

en: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.
zh: 明天他会在月球降落。

en: You'll find it difficult to meet her requirements.
zh: 你会发现难以满足她。

en: What he says is total nonsense.
zh: 他说的话不合情理。

en: She sometimes gets depressed.
zh: 她偶爾有憂鬱的心情。

en: Soccer is my favorite sport.
zh: 足球是我最喜欢的运动。

en: That white parasol is hers.
zh: 那把白色阳伞是她的。

en: This is a pun.
zh: 这是个文字游戏。

en: Tom is a natural athlete.
zh: 汤姆天生就是个运动员。

en: We will endeavour to finish the job by the end of the week.
zh: 我們會盡力在這禮拜結束前把工作完成。

en: My grandmother mailed the letter this morning.
zh: 今天早上我祖母寄出了这封信。

en: I'm in a desperate situation.
zh: 我處在絕境。

en: He even called me an idiot.
zh: 他甚至骂我傻瓜。

en: I just wanted to check my email.
zh: 我只想查一下我的电子邮件。

en: There are many endangered species.
zh: 有許多瀕危物种。

en: Tom's new girlfriend is a vegetarian.
zh: 汤姆新的女朋友是素食主义者。

en: Do you have a mobile phone?
zh: 你有手機嗎？

en: The doctor told me I had to stop smoking.
zh: 醫生告訴我, 我應該停止吸煙。

en: Is this seat available?
zh: 这个位子空着吗？

en: He has been secretly in love with her.
zh: 他一直暗恋着她。

en: This mountain is covered in snow all year round.
zh: 这座山全年覆盖着雪。

en: Last year in the Philippines, earthquakes and tidal waves resulted in the deaths of more than 6,000 people.
zh: 菲律賓去年地震和海嘯造成了超過6000人的死亡。

en: Tom is a rabbi.
zh: 汤姆是个拉比。

en: Mary prefers to dye her hair blonde.
zh: 玛丽更想把头发染成金色。

en: If he is innocent, then his wife is guilty.
zh: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。

en: There used to be a big cherry tree behind my house.
zh: 我家后面曾经有棵大樱桃树。

en: Tom is an ignorant fool.
zh: 汤姆是个无知的傻子。

en: The deadline is approaching.
zh: 期限近了。

en: I'm cold. Would you mind turning the heating on?
zh: 我很冷。你介意把暖气打开吗？

en: Tom is hiding a terrible secret.
zh: 汤姆隐藏着一个可怕的秘密。

en: The students are currently on holiday.
zh: 现在学生在放假。

en: This dictionary has about 40,000 entries.
zh: 这本字典包含了约4万个词条。

en: Are you referring to me?
zh: 你在说我吗？

en: I saw a beautiful waterfall there.
zh: 我看见那儿有个很美的瀑布。

en: Don't go over the speed limit.
zh: 不要超速。

en: I will get you a bike for your birthday.
zh: 你生日的时候，我送你一辆自行车。

en: India is a developing country.
zh: 印度是发展中国家。

en: Some say that China was like a Russian colony.
zh: 有人說中國像是俄國的殖民地。

en: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.
zh: “滚石不生苔”是一句谚语。

en: Today I'm feeling melancholic.
zh: 今天我很憂鬱。

en: She has a pure heart.
zh: 她有一颗纯洁的心。

en: She looks young. However, she's actually over forty.
zh: 她看起来是年轻的，但实际上她四十多岁了。

en: I don't want to spoil the ending for you.
zh: 我不想把結局提前透露給你。

en: Tom is an unknown artist.
zh: Tom是個不知名的藝術家。

en: A white dove is on the roof.
zh: 屋顶上有只白鸽。

en: Did you go to the book fair?
zh: 你去書展了嗎？

en: Hand me the remote.
zh: 把遥控器递给我。

en: I bathe every day.
zh: 我每天都洗澡。

en: "I feel like playing cards." "So do I."
zh: “我想打牌。”“我也是。”

en: How much does he earn in a month?
zh: 他每个月挣多少？

en: Tom is shy and cowardly.
zh: 汤姆害羞胆怯。

en: What's the worst-case scenario?
zh: 最坏的情境是什么？

en: His company didn't survive the crisis.
zh: 他的公司沒有從危機中倖存。

en: The archer killed the deer.
zh: 射手打死了鹿。

en: How long do you plan on staying here?
zh: 你打算在这儿待多久？

en: The mother occasionally reread her son's letter.
zh: 这位母亲偶尔会重温她的儿子的信件。

en: I did not expect it to be that big.
zh: 我没想到它有那么大。

en: What's the minimum wage in your country?
zh: 你的国家的最低工资是多少？

en: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.
zh: 如果你发现错误，那就请你纠正它。

en: The election was unanimous.
zh: 选举一致通过了。

en: I looked after him for a period of time.
zh: 我看了他一段时间。

en: Quite a lot of friends and acquaintances have come.
zh: 好多朋友和熟人来了。

en: When I was a child, I spent most of my time indoors reading.
zh: 当我是个孩子的时候，我会把大部分时间都用于室内阅读。

en: One million people lost their lives in the war.
zh: 100万人在战争中失去了生命。

en: Someone smashed the windshield of my new car.
zh: 有人把我新车的挡风玻璃砸碎了。

en: The fuel gauge is broken.
zh: 燃油表坏了。

en: Please divide the pizza into three parts.
zh: 請把披薩分成三份。

en: Democracy is the worst form of government, except all the others that have been tried.
zh: 除了那些我们尝试过的政府形态，民主是最差的那种了。

en: Reading a book can be compared to a journey.
zh: 阅读一本书可以比作一次旅行。

en: She can do both at the same time.
zh: 她可以同時做這兩件事。

en: I saw Tom having an argument with Mary.
zh: 我看到湯姆跟瑪麗爭論。

en: Tom lives in a slum.
zh: 汤姆住在贫民窟里。

en: Do you have any siblings?
zh: 你有兄弟姐妹吗？

en: Fish such as carp and trout live in fresh water.
zh: 鱼类例如鲤鱼和鳟鱼生活在淡水中。

en: As everyone knows, air is a mixture of gases.
zh: 众所周知，空气是多种气体的混合体。

en: We intended to let you in on the secret.
zh: 我们打算让你知道这个秘密。

en: He is a promising student.
zh: 他是一位有前途的学生。

en: The camel can go a long time without water and food.
zh: 駱駝可以撐很久不吃不喝。

en: They were left speechless.
zh: 他们惊得目瞪口呆。

en: The policeman didn't tow your car away.
zh: 警察沒有拖走你的車。

en: She has achieved her goals.
zh: 她达到了目标。

en: He was considered very qualified for the job.
zh: 人们认为，他完全能胜任这个工作。

en: He's the only survivor in the village.
zh: 他是村子里面唯一在世的人。

en: Things are the same, but people have changed.
zh: 物是人非。

en: People, old and young, all came out to greet the guests.
zh: 无论老幼，人们都出来迎接贵客。

en: Every nation, rich or poor, has its strengths and weaknesses.
zh: 每个国家，无论贫富，都有其长，都有其短。

en: Turn the volume up so that the students at the back can hear.
zh: 声音大声一点，以便让坐在后边的学生能听到。

en: He crept out of the room very carefully to avoid waking her up.
zh: 他很小心地溜出房间，以免惊醒她。

en: Are you aware of how much she loves you?
zh: 你知道她有多麼愛你嗎?

en: She used margarine instead of butter.
zh: 她用人造黄油代替了黄油。

en: The river's water level has risen.
zh: 河的水位上升了。

en: How much money do you have hidden under your bed?
zh: 你在你的床下面藏了多少钱？

en: You must be careful not to make him angry.
zh: 你要小心別惹他生氣。

en: Their apples aren't as tasty as ours.
zh: 他们的苹果没有我们的好吃。

en: You must take his age into account.
zh: 你该考虑他的年纪。

en: You should have helped him with his work.
zh: 你應該幫他工作的。

en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.
zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。

en: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.
zh: 让卫星环绕地球的是重力。

en: I have received a letter from a friend.
zh: 我收到了朋友的一封信。

en: Beer is sold by the pint.
zh: 啤酒论品脱卖。

en: Milk is sold by the pint.
zh: 牛奶论品脱卖。

en: A square has four angles.
zh: 正方形有四个角。

en: She had scarcely finished speaking when he cut in.
zh: 她几乎没有说完话，就被他打断了。

en: What subject do you think he is interested in?
zh: 你觉得他会对什么主题感兴趣？

en: Do you know how to cook meat?
zh: 你知道怎麼煮肉嗎?

en: You could count to ten when you were two.
zh: 在你兩歲時, 你可以數到十。

en: Can you tell wheat from barley?
zh: 你能辨别小麦和大麦吗？

en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
zh: 你长大后想成为什么？

en: You know quite a lot about sumo.
zh: 你很瞭解相撲。

en: Can you eat raw oysters?
zh: 你能生吃牡蠣嗎？

en: You have to get this work finished by noon.
zh: 你必須在中午以前完成這個工作。

en: You will soon get used to speaking in public.
zh: 你很快就會習慣在公開場合講話了。

en: Are any seats still available?
zh: 還剩座位嗎？

en: Why are you so insecure?
zh: 为什么你这么没有安全感？

en: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
zh: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。

en: Tom respects his elders.
zh: Tom尊敬他的長輩。

en: You should be ashamed of your ignorance.
zh: 你應該為你的無知感到羞恥。

en: I like dragon fruit.
zh: 我喜欢火龙果。

en: Life without love is just totally pointless.
zh: 没有爱情的生活毫无意义。

en: You ought to have come to see me yesterday.
zh: 你昨天應該來看我的。

en: You look very charming today.
zh: 今天你看起来很迷人啊。

en: Are you a senior high school student?
zh: 你是個高中生嗎?

en: I want to ask him for his phone number.
zh: 我想問他要電話號碼。

en: He survived an accident last year, but still drives recklessly.
zh: 他去年在事故中幸存了，可是他仍然很魯莽地開車。

en: I tried in vain to deal with the problem.
zh: 我想解決這個問題，可是白費功夫。

en: You should do the honorable thing and resign.
zh: 你應該光榮地辭職。

en: What do you base your theory on?
zh: 你的理論是以什麼為基礎?

en: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?
zh: 你曾經夢想在天空飛翔嗎？

en: You can get a loan from a bank.
zh: 你可以从银行贷款。

en: You should make an effort to stop smoking.
zh: 你應該努力去戒煙。

en: You're stepping into dangerous territory.
zh: 你進入了危險區。

en: Sooner or later his luck will run out.
zh: 遲早他的運氣會用完。

en: You seem to be prejudiced against ideas that come from foreign countries.
zh: 你似乎對來自國外的想法有偏見。

en: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.
zh: 你每次都继续犯同样的错误。

en: What time are you going on duty?
zh: 你幾點值班?

en: You're too suspicious about everything.
zh: 你对什么都太怀疑了。

en: I wonder if you have something to write with.
zh: 我懷疑你是否有東西可寫。

en: Do you belong to any clubs?
zh: 您隶属哪家俱乐部吗？

en: You are not a coward.
zh: 你不是个懦夫。

en: You should return home before it gets dark.
zh: 你應該在天黑之前回家。

en: You have a good sense of humor.
zh: 你很有幽默感。

en: You should have completed it long ago.
zh: 你们很久前就应该完成了。

en: You are now an adult.
zh: 你现在是大人了。

en: You nearly poked me in the eye with your pencil.
zh: 你的鉛筆差點戳到我的眼睛了。

en: He behaves as if he were insane.
zh: 他表现得像疯了一样。

en: You should practice playing the violin every day.
zh: 你應該每天練習拉小提琴。

en: I hope you have sweet dreams.
zh: 祝你好梦。

en: Why are you showing me this?
zh: 你给我看这个干嘛？

en: I have to stop procrastinating.
zh: 我不能再拖延了。

en: A cat has a tail and four legs.
zh: 一隻貓有一條尾巴和四隻腳。

en: You smoke far too much. You should cut back.
zh: 你吸太多煙了。你應該少抽一點。

en: Tom frequently talks in his sleep.
zh: 汤姆经常说梦话。

en: You will not be able to catch the train.
zh: 你將無法趕上火車。

en: I want to write an article.
zh: 我想写篇文章。

en: You owe me an apology for that.
zh: 关于那件事你欠我一个道歉。

en: Are you planning to take part in the meeting?
zh: 你们准备参加会议吗？

en: You must get rid of that bad habit.
zh: 你必须改掉这个坏习惯。

en: Is there a youth hostel near here?
zh: 附近有没有青年旅舍？

en: Do you deny that you went there?
zh: 你否認你去了那裡嗎?

en: Tom is consoling Mary.
zh: 汤姆在安慰玛丽。

en: I am not wearing any underwear.
zh: 我沒穿內衣。

en: Have you still not finished paying for my bike?
zh: 你还没有为我的自行车付完款吗？

en: You should have told me a long time ago.
zh: 很久以前你就應該告訴我的。

en: You've got a lot of guts.
zh: 你膽子很大。

en: You will soon get accustomed to your new school.
zh: 你很快就会适应你的新学校。

en: What are you staring at?
zh: 你在看什麼？

en: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
zh: 你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。

en: He's a meth addict.
zh: 他是个吸毒男。

en: Love is like oxygen.
zh: 爱就像氧气。

en: You must be mentally exhausted.
zh: 你肯定脑子糊掉了。

en: You are always complaining.
zh: 你總是在抱怨。

en: You must be tired after such a long trip.
zh: 在這麼長程的旅途後你一定很累了。

en: I wish you had told me the truth then.
zh: 但願你那時候就告訴我真相。

en: My grandpa believes that the moon landing was a hoax.
zh: 我的祖父相信登月是一個騙局。

en: You may as well tell me all about it.
zh: 你不妨告訴我一切。

en: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
zh: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该重新审视我们的计划。

en: Please give me your permanent address.
zh: 請給我你的永久地址。

en: Your prophecy has come true.
zh: 你的预言成真了。

en: I admire you for your courage.
zh: 我佩服你的勇氣。

en: You have lovely eyes, don't you?
zh: 你有一雙可愛的眼睛，不是嗎?

en: Your driver's license has expired.
zh: 你的駕駛執照已經過期了。

en: What grade is your sister in?
zh: 你的妹妹唸幾年級？

en: Please give my regards to your father.
zh: 请替我向你父亲问好。

en: Your proposal is a bit extreme.
zh: 你的建議有點極端。

en: A huge monster is coming down the mountain.
zh: 从山上走来一只巨大的怪物。

en: I have numerous books on my bookshelf.
zh: 我有大量的书在我的书架上。

en: Yesterday, an explosion occurred at the fireworks factory.
zh: 昨晚，烟花厂发生了爆炸。

en: She was pleased with the new dress.
zh: 那条新裙子让她很满意。

en: I will give you a bicycle for your birthday.
zh: 你生日的时候，我送你一辆自行车。

en: I was glad to hear of your success.
zh: 我很高兴知道你成功了。

en: How did you come up with this crazy idea?
zh: 你是怎麼想到這麼瘋狂的主意的？

en: She works with single-minded determination.
zh: 她一心一意地工作。

en: Would you mind lending me your car?
zh: 你介意把你的車借給我嗎?

en: Your composition has a few mistakes.
zh: 你的作文有一些錯誤。

en: Explain to him the difficult situation you are in.
zh: 给他讲解一下你的困境。

en: He sketched an apple.
zh: 他畫了一張蘋果素描。

en: Your behavior leaves much to be desired.
zh: 你的行为离要求的太远了。

en: How are you? Did you have a good trip?
zh: 你怎么样？旅游愉快吗？

en: Thank you for baking this delicious cake.
zh: 谢谢你烤的美味蛋糕。

en: Thank you for drawing a bird for me.
zh: 謝謝你為我畫鳥。

en: Your view is too optimistic.
zh: 你的看法過於樂觀。

en: I am amazed at your audacity.
zh: 我对你的厚颜无耻感到惊讶。

en: The children returned home at dusk.

en: Hang on till I get to you.
zh: 坚持下去直到我找到你。

en: The taxi I took was very old and small.
zh: 我打的这辆出租车很老，也很小。

en: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.
zh: 好几间小屋被洪水孤立起来了。

en: How often do you have to see the dentist?
zh: 你多久看一次牙医？

en: The horse stopped and refused to go on.
zh: 馬停了下來，而且拒絕移動。

en: What I have in my hand is a fossil seashell.
zh: 在我手裡的是一個貝殼化石。

en: What are you concerned about?
zh: 你在担心什么呢？

en: The boy I thought was honest deceived me.
zh: 那个我以为诚实的男孩欺骗了我。

en: I was having a bath when the telephone rang.
zh: 在我洗澡的时候，电话响了。

en: Not knowing what to say, he remained silent.
zh: 因為不知道該說什麼, 他保持沉默。

en: I invited him to the party and he accepted.
zh: 我邀请他去派对，他接受了。

en: He will be my deputy while I am away.
zh: 我不在的时候，他将是我的代理人。

en: Her garden is a work of art.
zh: 她的花园是一件艺术作品。

en: Speak more slowly so that we can understand you.
zh: 请讲慢一点，让我们能听懂。

en: You were considerate not to disturb us.
zh: 你考虑周到，没有打扰我们。

en: Who is that boy running toward us?
zh: 那个朝我们跑过来的男孩是谁？

en: Our math teacher drew a circle on the blackboard.
zh: 我们的数学老师在黑板上画了一个圆。

en: Our teacher has a wonderful sense of humor.
zh: 我们的老师非常有幽默感。

en: Tom always sings out of tune.
zh: 汤姆唱歌总跑调。

en: What is that big building in front of us?
zh: 我们面前的这幢高楼是什么？

en: You should put safety before everything else.
zh: 你應該把安全放在其他一切之上。

en: I'm not very athletic.
zh: 我不太擅长运动。

en: We had a heart-to-heart talk with each other.
zh: 我们促膝谈心。

en: We went down a river by canoe.
zh: 我們乘著獨木舟向河的下游而行。

en: You have no need to be ashamed.
zh: 你不需要害羞。

en: We gave blood to help the child.
zh: 我們捐血來幫助這個孩子。

en: Tom cleared his throat and continued to speak.
zh: 汤姆咳嗽了一下然后接着讲。

en: We went down to the valley where the village is.
zh: 我們下到山谷裡，那裡有個村莊。

en: We had a heated discussion about it.
zh: 我們激烈的討論了這個問題。

en: We took strong measures to prevent it.
zh: 我们使用了强大的措施来预防。

en: We must keep up the family traditions.
zh: 我们必须保持家庭传统。

en: We hurried in the direction of the fire.
zh: 我們急忙跑向火。

en: Tom carefully wiped his fingerprints off the knife.
zh: 汤姆小心翼翼地把刀子上的指纹擦掉。

en: We moved our bags to make room for the elderly lady to sit down.
zh: 我們移走了行李騰出空間讓老太太可以坐下。

en: We must conform to the rules.
zh: 我们必须遵守规则。

en: What kind of sandwich do you want?
zh: 你要什麼樣的三明治？

en: We set a trap to catch a fox.
zh: 我们设了个陷阱来抓狐狸。

en: We are bound to each other by a close friendship.
zh: 友谊紧紧联系着我们。

en: I have a black and a white dog.
zh: 我有一只黑狗和一只白狗。

en: We went halfway up the mountain.
zh: 我們爬到了半山腰。

en: We bought some vegetables and fish at the market.
zh: 我们在市场上买了些蔬菜和鱼。

en: We made an appeal for support.
zh: 我們提出了請求支持的呼籲。

en: We must learn to live in harmony with nature.
zh: 我们必须学会与自然和谐共处。

en: We should try to avoid imposing our own beliefs on others.
zh: 我們應該盡量避免把我們自己的信念強加在別人身上。

en: We loaded a lot of luggage into the car.
zh: 我們往車裡装了很多行李。

en: We gather here once a week.
zh: 我们每周在这儿聚一次。

en: Everything Tom predicted came true.
zh: 汤姆说的预言全部都应验了。

en: All of Tom's predictions came true.
zh: 汤姆说的预言全部都应验了。

en: We are badly in need of food.
zh: 我们非常需要食物。

en: We went for a walk in the forest.
zh: 我们去了林中散步。

en: We were in danger of losing our lives.
zh: 我們險些丟了命。

en: We found some dead fish in the river.
zh: 我們在河裡發現了一些死魚。

en: We are encouraged to use our imagination.
zh: 我們被鼓勵使用想像力。

en: We have to fix the date for our trip quickly.
zh: 我们必须快点定下旅游日期。

en: We played basketball in the gym.
zh: 我們在體育館打籃球。

en: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.
zh: 这个实验室配备了最新的计算机。

en: We suspected him of lying.
zh: 我们怀疑他说谎了。

en: We elected her captain of our team.
zh: 我们选她为我们队的队长。

en: We elected her chairperson.
zh: 我們選她為主席。

en: I beg your pardon?
zh: 不好意思，能请您重复一遍吗？

en: We got lost in the fog.
zh: 我们在雾中迷了路。

en: Do you have a soup bowl?
zh: 你有湯碗嗎？

en: Tom is in the living room, sleeping on the couch.
zh: 湯姆在客廳長沙發上睡覺。

en: There must be some misunderstanding between us.
zh: 我们之间肯定有误会。

en: She gave me a smile of recognition.
zh: 她給了我一個認可的微笑。

en: Can I be of any service to you?
zh: 你需要我帮忙吗？

en: Please give me a hamburger.
zh: 請給我一個漢堡。

en: I can seldom find time for reading.
zh: 我很少能抽出时间看书。

en: It seems to me that she is a little selfish.
zh: 我觉得她有点自私。

en: I have nothing to complain about.
zh: 我沒有什麼可抱怨的。

en: I have a friend whose father is a magician.
zh: 我一哥們兒他爹是變戲法的。

en: I have a friend whose father is a teacher.
zh: 我有一個朋友, 他的父親是老師。

en: I have a friend whose father is a famous novelist.
zh: 我有一位朋友，他的父親是著名小說家。

en: Don't yell at me.
zh: 別對著我吼。

en: My nephew is allergic to eggs.
zh: 我侄子對雞蛋過敏。

en: Are you taking any medicine regularly?
zh: 你經常服用任何藥物嗎？

en: My grandfather is a carpenter.
zh: 我爺爺是個木匠。

en: My aunt grows tomatoes in her garden.
zh: 我阿姨在她的花園種蕃茄。

en: My girlfriend is a good dancer.
zh: 我的女朋友跳舞跳得很棒。

en: My canary was killed by a cat.
zh: 我的金絲雀被一隻貓殺死了。

en: My camera is waterproof.
zh: 我的照相机是防水的。

en: Please don't misunderstand me.
zh: 千万别误会我的意思。

en: Please keep an eye on my suitcase.
zh: 請留神看著我的手提箱。

en: You can have a ride on my motorcycle.
zh: 你可以骑上我的摩托车去遛一圈。

en: My house is fully insured.
zh: 我的房子绝对保险。

en: My house is five blocks away.
zh: 我家离这里五个街区远。

en: My house is close to a bus stop.
zh: 我的房子靠近一個公車站牌。

en: My house is old and ugly.
zh: 我的房子又舊又難看。

en: Did you have any difficulty in finding my house?
zh: 你找我的房子有困難嗎？

en: There are seven men and four women in my section.
zh: 在我的部门里有七男四女。

en: My briefcase is full of papers.
zh: 我的公事包裡裝滿了文件。

en: Did you make any New Year's resolutions?
zh: 你有沒有許下什麼新年願望？

en: My brother is holding a camera in his hand.
zh: 我弟弟手里拿着一个摄像机。

en: My dog follows me wherever I go.
zh: 無論我去哪裡，我的狗都跟著我。

en: My dog often lies on the grass.
zh: 我家的狗經常躺在草地上。

en: My dog goes everywhere with me.
zh: 我的狗總是跟著我。

en: I had my composition corrected by the teacher.
zh: 我把我的作文拿給老師訂正。

en: My business has at last gotten on the right track.
zh: 我的生意終於上了軌道。

en: My office is on the fifth floor.
zh: 我的辦公室在五樓。

en: There's a doghouse in the yard.
zh: 院子里的是狗屋。

en: My watch is very accurate.
zh: 我的手錶很準。

en: Do you subscribe to any magazines?
zh: 你有訂閱任何雜誌嗎？

en: My car is at your disposal.
zh: 你可以随便用我的车。

en: My hobby is playing the piano.
zh: 我的嗜好就是彈鋼琴。

en: I wonder if what I wrote was correct.
zh: 我在想我寫的對不對。

en: Please accept my sincere apologies.
zh: 請接受我誠摯的歉意。

en: According to my calculation, she should be in India by now.
zh: 根據我的估計，她現在應該在印度了。

en: I owe my success to his help.
zh: 我的成功要归功于他。

en: There are three empty rooms. However, we can't use any of them.
zh: 虽然有三间空屋，但哪间都用不了。

en: Where should I put my laundry?
zh: 我應該把我要洗的衣服放在哪裡?

en: My grandfather died when I was a boy.
zh: 當我是個小男孩的時候，我的祖父就過世了。

en: My grandfather lived to be ninety.
zh: 我的祖父活到了九十歲。

en: Thank you for the present you gave my son.
zh: 谢谢你送给我儿子礼物。

en: My son is engaged to his secretary.
zh: 我的兒子和他的秘書訂婚了。

en: As far as I know, he did nothing wrong.
zh: 据我所知，他没做错任何事。

en: As far as I know, she is still missing.
zh: 据我所知，她仍然失踪。

en: My father used to drink till late at night.
zh: 过去，我父亲常常喝酒直到深夜。

en: My father was no less affectionate and tender to me than my mother was.
zh: 我爸爸对我的爱和照顾不比我妈妈少。

en: My father is always poking his nose into my private life.
zh: 我的父亲总是干涉我的私生活。

en: My father is an office worker.
zh: 我父親是一名辦公室職員。

en: My father is very much involved in the stock market now.
zh: 我爸爸现在非常专注于股市。

en: My father has been engaged in foreign trade for many years.
zh: 我父亲经营外贸多年。

en: We were astonished to hear what had happened.
zh: 我们听到所发生的事，感到很惊讶。

en: My father is retiring next spring.
zh: 我爸爸明年春天就要退休了。

en: My apartment is on the fourth floor.
zh: 我的公寓在四樓。

en: My room is three times as large as yours.
zh: 我的房間是你的三倍大。

en: I want something sweet to eat.
zh: 我想要吃甜的東西。

en: My room is upstairs on the left.
zh: 我的房間在樓上的左邊。

en: My ex-husband no longer lives in this city.
zh: 我前男友不再住在這個城市了。

en: My mother was disappointed by my failure.
zh: 我的母亲对我的失败感到失望。

en: My sister got married in her teens.
zh: 我妹妹在她十幾歲時就結婚。

en: My dream is to become a pilot.
zh: 我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。

en: My daughter is in her late teens.
zh: 我的女兒快二十歲了。

en: My daughter likes egg yolks.
zh: 我女儿喜欢蛋黄。

en: My parents' generation went through the war.
zh: 我父母那一代经历过战争。

en: The man sitting next to me spoke to me.
zh: 坐在我旁边的男人跟我说话了。

en: I watched the game from beginning to end.
zh: 那场比赛，我从头看到尾。

en: Is there anything else you want me to do?
zh: 你还有什么事情需要我去做的吗？

en: I recommend it strongly.
zh: 我强力推荐它。

en: I was scared to be alone in the dark.
zh: 我害怕一个人处在黑暗之中。

en: I saw an old woman cross the street.
zh: 我看见一个老太太穿过了马路。

en: I'm a junior high school student.
zh: 我是個國中生。

en: I objected to his paying the bill.
zh: 我反對他付帳單。

en: I can't help admiring his talent.
zh: 我不禁欣賞他的才華。

en: I remember my mother teaching me the alphabet.
zh: 我记得我母亲教我认字。

en: I spent the whole day in reading the novel.
zh: 我一整天都在看这本小说。

en: I disagree with you.
zh: 我不同意你的看法。

en: Do we have anything I can snack on?
zh: 我們有任何我可以當零食吃的東西嗎？

en: I got scolded severely by that teacher.
zh: 我被那位老師嚴厲斥責了。

en: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
zh: 我在那商店花低價買了臺錄像機。

en: I bet ten dollars on that horse.
zh: 我在那匹馬下十美元的賭注。

en: Please keep me informed.
zh: 請通知我。

en: I will be a doctor someday.
zh: 我有朝一日会成为一名医生。

en: I got up early as usual.
zh: 我和平常一样起得早。

en: There is no point in pretending to be sick.
zh: 装病是没用的。

en: I always have trouble remembering names.
zh: 我经常忘记别人的名字。

en: I was abducted by aliens.
zh: 我被外星人绑架了。

en: I was given a nice watch by my uncle.
zh: 我叔叔给了我一块漂亮的手表。

en: I prefer hardwood floors to carpet.
zh: 我喜歡硬木地板勝過地毯。

en: I vaguely remember meeting him.
zh: 我依稀記得見過他。

en: I'd like to be a guitarist.
zh: 我想要成为吉他手。

en: I explained the reason in detail.
zh: 我詳細地解釋了原因。

en: I cut myself shaving this morning.
zh: 我今天早上刮鬍子的時候把自己弄傷了。

en: I spilled my coffee on the carpet.
zh: 我把咖啡倒翻在地毯上了。

en: I'm not accustomed to such treatment.
zh: 我不習慣這樣的待遇。

en: Translate the underlined part.
zh: 翻译划线部分。

en: I agree with you on this issue.
zh: 我同意你對這問題的看法。

en: I got this vacuum cleaner for nothing.
zh: 我免費得到了這個吸塵器。

en: You won't be able to see anything without a flashlight.
zh: 沒有手電筒的話你什麼都看不到

en: I can recommend this book to you.
zh: 我可以向你推薦這本書。

en: Tom opened the blinds and looked out the window.
zh: 汤姆打开百叶窗，向窗外望去。

en: Do you know if Tom has spoken to Mary recently?
zh: 你知不知道最近湯姆跟瑪麗說過話沒有？

en: I thought we were going to do this together.
zh: 我認為我們要一起做。

en: Tom and Mary switched places on the bench.
zh: 汤姆和玛丽在长凳上交换了位置。

en: Tom is the manager of a small restaurant.
zh: 汤姆是一家小餐馆的经理。

en: Tom blew out all the candles on the cake.
zh: 汤姆吹灭了蛋糕上的所有蜡烛。

en: I have to get my computer repaired.
zh: 我必須把我的電腦拿去給人家修理。

en: I prefer walking to cycling.
zh: 我更愿意走路，而不是骑自行车。

en: I bought a bottle of salad oil.
zh: 我買了一瓶沙拉油。

en: I'm not particularly thirsty right now.
zh: 我现在不特别渴。

en: It looks like Tom has a crush on Mary.
zh: 看来汤姆热恋着玛丽。

en: Tom will regret that sooner or later.
zh: 湯姆遲早會後悔。

en: Tom took a spatula out of the drawer.
zh: 湯姆從抽屜裡拿出一把鍋鏟。

en: I want to buy a pair of ski boots.
zh: 我想买一双滑雪靴。

en: I cheered myself up by listening to music.
zh: 我藉由聽音樂來鼓舞我自己。

en: I am writing a draft of the speech.
zh: 我在寫演講的草稿。

en: I want to be a sport reporter.
zh: 我想成為一個體育記者。

en: I bought two pairs of trousers.
zh: 我买了两条裤子。

en: I was mistaken for a salesman.
zh: 我被誤認為是推銷員。

en: I tried to hit Tom, but he ducked.
zh: 我要去打汤姆，但是他避开了。

en: Few things give us as much pleasure as music.
zh: 很少有東西像音樂一樣帶給我們這麼多的快樂。

en: I'm severely allergic to peanuts.
zh: 我對花生嚴重過敏。

en: I'm going to help you rescue Tom.
zh: 我要幫你營救湯姆。

en: I can stay up as late as I want.
zh: 我熬夜熬多久都行。

en: Tom was hiding under the table.
zh: Tom躲在桌子底下。

en: I was very surprised to hear the news.
zh: 我听到这个消息很惊讶。

en: I have seen the film before.
zh: 我已经看过这部电影了。

en: The importance of music is underrated.
zh: 音乐的重要性被低估了。

en: I'm going to be a millionaire.
zh: 我就要成为百万富翁了。

en: I wonder if I can do it again.
zh: 我不知道我能不能再做一次。

en: I felt that the plan was unwise.
zh: 我覺得這計畫不是很聰明。

en: I had nothing to do with that incident.
zh: 我跟那个事件没有什么关系。

en: I was unable to complete the task.
zh: 我無法完成這個任務。

en: I was asked to umpire the game.
zh: 我被要求當這場比賽的裁判。

en: I'll be able to assist you.
zh: 我能協助你。

en: I got acquainted with the chief executive.
zh: 我認識了這位行政長官。

en: Tom is a little depressed.
zh: 汤姆有点沮丧。

en: I'm going to the restroom.
zh: 我去下洗手间。

en: I asked the boy to throw the ball back.
zh: 我請這個男孩把球扔回來。

en: I must make up for the loss.
zh: 我必须弥补损失。

en: I'm delighted to see you.
zh: 我很高兴见到你。

en: I have no recollection of seeing the man.
zh: 我沒有見過那男人的印象。

en: Do you have a suggestion?
zh: 你有什么建议吗？

en: Tom got out of the jeep.
zh: 汤姆从吉普车上下来了。

en: I have nothing to do with the crime.
zh: 这个犯罪和我一点关系都没有。

en: You're a celebrity now.
zh: 你现在是名人了。

en: Tom was not apologetic.
zh: Tom并不觉得抱歉。

en: I paid two thousand yen for the book.
zh: 我用两千日元买了这本书。

en: I'm here to assist you.
zh: 我來協助你。

en: Tom watched in horror.
zh: 汤姆惊恐地盯着。

en: Tom snickered at Mary.
zh: 湯姆暗中笑瑪麗。

en: Tom isn't a bad coach.
zh: 汤姆不是坏教练。

en: I attempted to solve the problem.
zh: 我試圖解決這個問題。

en: I gave careful consideration to the problem.
zh: 我仔細地考慮了這個問題。

en: How was the interview?
zh: 面試怎麼樣？

en: Can I fix you a hot drink?
zh: 我可以为你调杯热饮料吗？

en: The phone is ringing.
zh: 電話正在響。

en: I'm looking for a warm, woolen skirt.
zh: 我想找一件溫暖的羊毛裙。

en: How was the seminar?
zh: 研討會怎麼樣？

en: I'm losing my grip.
zh: 我失去了控制。

en: I usually got to bed about eleven.
zh: 我通常約十一點鐘上床睡覺。

en: I always take a bath before going to bed.
zh: 我睡觉前总要洗个澡。

en: I only took a bite of bread.
zh: 我仅仅吃了口面包。

en: This is a fake.
zh: 这是一个伪造品。

en: I can eat anything but onions.
zh: 除了洋葱我什么都可以吃。

en: The children haven't studied division yet.
zh: 孩子們還沒上過除法。

en: Tom is a distant relative of mine.
zh: 湯姆是我的遠亲。

en: I have just been to the post office.
zh: 我剛剛去了郵局。

en: I feel sad every now and then.
zh: 我不時地覺得難過。

en: I sometimes hear my father singing in the bathroom.

zh: 爸爸准许我去游泳。

en: My father has been in good shape since his operation.
zh: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。

en: My father is a bit old-fashioned.
zh: 我爸爸有点守旧。

en: My father will often read the newspaper during meals.
zh: 我父亲常在吃饭时看报纸。

en: My father put a fence around the garden.
zh: 我父亲在花园边上装了篱笆。

en: Are there any famous musicians on the stage?
zh: 舞台上有著名音乐家吗？

en: The room has a seating capacity of 200.
zh: 这个房间能容纳200人。

en: The balloon was caught in the tree.
zh: 這顆氣球被樹絆住了。

en: Mary seems to be bored with the game.
zh: 瑪麗似乎對這個遊戲感到無聊。

en: Do you know anything about complex carbohydrates?
zh: 你对复合碳水化合物有什么了解吗？

en: Put some salt into the boiling water.
zh: 放點鹽到滾水裡。

en: Prices have been climbing steadily.
zh: 價格一直在穩定地攀升。

en: Prices are double what they were ten years ago.
zh: 价钱是10年前的2倍。

en: Mary is helping her mother.
zh: 瑪麗正在幫忙她的母親。

en: Mark the words that you cannot understand.
zh: 你不懂的词做个记号。

en: Mix the flour with two eggs.
zh: 把麵粉和兩顆雞蛋混合。

en: A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
zh: 句子通常有主詞和動詞。

en: The only sound to be heard was the ticking of the clock.
zh: 唯一能听到的声音是钟的滴答声。

en: Mary had been knitting for an hour when I called.
zh: 我打電話過去時，瑪莉已經做了一小時的針線活兒。

en: Mary has as attractive a personality as her sister.
zh: 玛丽性格很好，就像她姐姐一样。

en: The soldier groaned with pain.
zh: 這名士兵痛苦地呻吟。

en: The soldiers lost the courage to fight.
zh: 士兵们失去了战斗的勇气。

en: The soldiers were guarding the bridge.
zh: 士兵們守衛著這座橋。

en: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.
zh: 平等是由宪法保障的。

en: It seems less crowded during the week.
zh: 平日似乎比較不擁擠。

en: Tell Tom I need to borrow his car.
zh: 告訴湯姆我需要借他的車。

en: I was the one who had to tell Tom.
zh: 该由我告诉汤姆。

en: Production of rice has decreased.
zh: 米的产量减少了。

en: Rice is sold by the kilogram.
zh: 米以公斤為單位來出售。

en: The United States is abundant in natural resources.
zh: 美国的自然资源很丰富。

en: Did Tom tell you it was an emergency?
zh: 你告诉汤姆那是紧急情况了吗？

en: Can you tell us a bit more about that?
zh: 能再告诉我一点吗？

en: His cottage is on the coast.
zh: 他的村屋在海岸上。

en: Please bill us separately.
zh: 請讓我們分開付錢。

en: Could you wrap this separately, please?
zh: 請你分開包裝好嗎？

en: Dust got into one of my eyes.
zh: 灰塵鑽進了我的一隻眼睛。

en: I'm sorry for the delay in responding.
zh: 我很抱歉這麼遲才回復。

en: Maybe I should just tell Tom the truth.
zh: 可能我就該告訴湯姆真相。

en: Tom told me to take good care of myself.
zh: 湯姆告訴我要照顧好我自己。

en: Tom told Mary he thought she was stupid.
zh: 汤姆告诉玛丽，他觉得她很傻。

en: Don't distract me while I am studying.
zh: 当我学习的时候不要打扰我。

en: Speech is silver, silence is golden.
zh: 开口是银，沉默是金。

en: We guarantee our products for one year.
zh: 我們保證我們的產品一年。

en: To tell you the truth, this is a little too spicy for me.
zh: 说实话，这对我来说有点太辣了。

en: When were you planning on telling Tom about what happened?
zh: 你准备啥时候告诉Tom发生了什么

en: I found a coin on the sidewalk.
zh: 我在人行道上發現了一枚硬幣。

en: I hear from my mother once in a while.
zh: 我时不时得到母亲的消息。

en: Her eyes shone with joy when she saw that her mother was not mad at her.
zh: 當她看到媽媽沒在生她的氣，她的雙眼因為幸福而閃爍了。

en: Maternal love is greater than anything else.
zh: 母爱比任何别的东西都伟大。

en: My mother did nothing but weep.
zh: 我的母亲只是默默地哭泣。

en: My mother didn't let me wear a miniskirt.
zh: 我妈不让我穿迷你裙。

en: My mother often bakes apple pies for us.
zh: 母亲经常为我们做苹果派。

en: My mother teaches flower arranging.
zh: 我母親教插花藝術。

en: Mother gives my sister two thousand yen every month.
zh: 母親每個月給妹妹兩千日元。

en: The mother missed her daughter who was away at college.
zh: 妈妈想念她在读大学的女儿。

en: I'm breast-feeding my baby.
zh: 我餵我的孩子母乳。

en: He cleansed the wound before putting on a bandage.
zh: 他先清洗了伤口，再绑上绷带。

en: Let's split the reward fifty-fifty.
zh: 讓我們平分這個報酬吧。

en: I won the lottery.
zh: 我中奖了。

en: They were all hoarse from shouting.
zh: 他們全都叫到沙啞了。

en: All men are equal under the law.
zh: 法律之前人人平等。

en: Respect for law is fundamental to our society.
zh: 尊重法律是我們社會的基礎。

en: The law should not be violated.
zh: 法律不應受到侵犯。

en: The court acquitted him of the charge of murder.
zh: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。

en: We all like cycling.
zh: 我们都喜欢骑自行车。

en: I got a bee sting.
zh: 我被蜜蜂蛰了一下。

en: Bee stings can be very painful.
zh: 蜜蜂螫人可以是非常痛苦的。

en: Visitors are usually asked to remove their shoes before they enter a Japanese house.
zh: 访客通常在进入一户日本人家之前会被要求脱鞋。

en: I hung my hat on the peg.
zh: 我把我的帽子掛在掛鉤上。

en: An unforgettable event occurred.
zh: 一场令人难忘的事件发生了。

en: It is difficult to satisfy everyone.
zh: 众口难调。

en: There was only one warden on duty when the riot started.
zh: 暴動開始時只有一位監獄長值班。

en: The gang was planning a robbery.
zh: 這夥人計劃搶劫。

en: Trade barriers were lifted after the war ended.
zh: 戰爭結束之後貿易障礙被解除。

en: I could not afford to buy a bicycle.
zh: 我买不起自行车。

en: Please make a milkshake for me.
zh: 請幫我做個奶昔。

en: I brush my teeth twice a day.
zh: 我一天刷兩次牙。

en: Everybody wants to sit beside her.
zh: 大家都想坐在她旁边。

en: I turned the doorknob.
zh: 我轉動了門把。

en: I like instrumental music.
zh: 我喜歡器樂。

en: I made a long journey last year.
zh: 我去年做了一次長途旅行。

en: I got a farewell present from everyone.
zh: 每個人都送了我一份歡送禮物。

en: I asked him point-blank.
zh: 我直接地問了他。

en: I aimed my gun at the target.
zh: 我把我的手枪指向了目标。

en: I'm a night owl.
zh: 我是個夜貓子。

en: At the age of six, I was taken to a circus for the first time.
zh: 在我六岁的时候，我第一次被带去看马戏。

en: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.
zh: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。

en: A true gentleman would not betray his friends.
zh: 一个真正的绅士不会出卖他的朋友。

en: Real friendship is more valuable than money.
zh: 真正的友谊比金钱更有价值。

en: A true friend would not say such a thing.
zh: 如果真的是朋友的话，是不会说这样的话的吧。

en: The drug problem is international.
zh: 毒品是国际性的问题。

en: My sister resembles my mother.
zh: 我妹妹很像我妈妈。

en: How much is your monthly gas bill?
zh: 你每個月的瓦斯費多少錢？

en: I walk my dog in the park every morning.
zh: 我每天早上到公园里遛狗。

en: A great number of books are published every year.
zh: 每年都有大量新书出版。

en: Could I have a pillow and blanket?
zh: 給我一個枕頭和毛毯好嗎？

en: Ladies and gentlemen, due to an accident at the airport, our arrival will be delayed.
zh: 女士們，先生們，由於機場的意外情況，我們的著陸將被推遲。

en: This is a dangerous mission.
zh: 這是個危險的任務。

en: My pulse is fast.
zh: 我的脉搏很快。

en: Tom found Mary's constant criticism of him hard to cope with.
zh: 汤姆认为和经常批评他的玛丽很难相处。

en: A boat suddenly appeared out of the mist.
zh: 一艘船突然从雾中出现。

en: Please add my name to the list.
zh: 請在名單上加上我的名字。

en: I found this at the risk of my life.
zh: 我冒著生命危險找到了這個。

en: Clearly you are mistaken.
zh: 顯然的，你錯了。

en: Someone is obviously telling a lie.
zh: 顯然有人在撒謊。

en: She waved her hand to me, smiling brightly.
zh: 她笑眯眯的对我招手。

en: Will you pick me up at seven tomorrow morning?
zh: 你明早7点来接我吗？

en: Please remind me to mail the report tomorrow.
zh: 请提醒我明天把报告寄了。

en: Can you be ready to leave tomorrow?
zh: 明天你能準備好離開嗎？

en: These ruins are ancient.
zh: 这些废墟年代久远。

en: I felt as if I were in a dream.
zh: 我感觉就像做梦一样。

en: It's hard to predict what the weather will be like tomorrow.
zh: 很难说明天的天气将会怎样。

en: Tomorrow's weather should be sunny with occasional rain.
zh: 明天天气晴转阵雨。

en: I wonder what the weather will be like tomorrow.
zh: 不知道明天天气会怎么样呢？

en: You'll have to play it by ear at the interview.
zh: 在面試的時候你必須見機行事。

en: Fur coats are on sale.
zh: 毛皮大衣在打折。

en: Beware of the dog!
zh: 小心狗！

en: We made good time until we ran into a blizzard.
zh: 我们路上一帆风顺，直到遇上暴风雪。

en: Malaria is carried by mosquitoes.
zh: 瘧疾是由蚊子傳染的。

en: I had to take shelter under a tree.
zh: 我不得不在树下躲雨。

en: The trees are beginning to bud.
zh: 树木开始抽芽。

en: I thought it best to remain silent.
zh: 我想最好還是保持沉默。

en: I overslept because my alarm didn't go off.
zh: 因为闹铃没有响，所以我继续睡下去了。

en: The end does not always justify the means.
zh: 為了正當目的並非總是可以不擇手段.

en: The problem is that solar energy costs too much.
zh: 問題是, 太陽能太貴了。

en: There is a path through the fields.
zh: 有条小路穿过农田。

en: Wild animals live in the forest.
zh: 野生動物住在森林裡。

en: Bird watching is a nice hobby.
zh: 观察鸟类是个很好的业余爱好。

en: The arrow indicates the way to go.
zh: 箭头表示行进方向。

en: You just saved me a lot of time.
zh: 你省了我好多時間。

en: The kettle is boiling.
zh: 茶壺沸了。

en: A fox isn't caught twice in the same snare.
zh: 一只狐狸不会两次掉入同一个陷阱里。

en: Oil will float on water.
zh: 油漂浮在水上。

en: A friend of mine asked me to send her a postcard.
zh: 我的一位朋友要求我寄給她一張明信片。

en: It's valid until March thirty-first, nineteen-ninety-seven.
zh: 有效期到1997年3月31日为止。

en: A famous architect built this house.
zh: 一个有名的建筑师造了这个房子。

en: The kidnappers showed no sign of giving up.
zh: 這些綁匪沒有放棄的跡象。

en: You must not yield to temptation.
zh: 你不應該屈服在誘惑之下。

en: I had a slight headache last night.
zh: 我昨晚有輕微的頭痛。

en: Thank you for inviting me to dinner.
zh: 谢谢你邀请我吃饭。

en: I was caught in a shower and got drenched to the skin.
zh: 我遇上了陣雨被淋得全身濕透。

en: We are traveling on a tight budget.
zh: 我們很節省地旅行。

en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

en: All subscriptions must be paid before the end of this year.
zh: 所有訂購必須在今年年底前支付款項。

en: Are there reserved seats on the train?
zh: 火車上有預訂的座位嗎？

en: They consider it impolite to disagree with someone they don't know very well.
zh: 他们认为，去反驳一个不认识的人有些不礼貌。

en: Don't confuse desire with love.
zh: 不要把欲望和爱情混为一谈。

en: I weighed myself on the bathroom scales.
zh: 我用浴室的体重计量了体重。

en: Call me when you get settled in.
zh: 你安頓好就打電話給我。

en: The shell of an egg is easily broken.
zh: 蛋壳容易破碎。

en: They announced that a storm was coming.
zh: 他們宣布了暴風雨即將來臨。

en: The sky cleared up soon after the storm.
zh: 风暴之后不久,天空就晴朗起来了。

en: I think it's dangerous to climb a mountain on a day when it's stormy.
zh: 我認為在有風暴的時候裡登山很危險。

en: The storm caused a lot of damage.
zh: 暴風雨造成了很大的損害。

en: The storm didn't abate for several hours.
zh: 风暴几个小时没有减弱了。

en: The storm developed into a typhoon.
zh: 暴風雨發展成了一個颱風。

en: Theory and practice should go hand in hand.
zh: 理论得联系实际。

en: Frankly speaking, I don't agree with you.
zh: 实话说，我不赞成你。

en: I was vaccinated against the flu.
zh: 我接种了流感疫苗。

en: I would like to speak English fluently.
zh: 我想把英語說得很流利。

en: I am saving money in order to study abroad.
zh: 我正存钱出国留学。

en: Sulfur burns with a blue flame.
zh: 硫磺燃燒著藍色的火焰。

en: Excuse me for opening your letter by mistake.
zh: 對不起, 我錯開了你的信。

en: This guidebook might be of use to you on your trip.
zh: 这本导游册子或许会对你的旅行有帮助。

en: Mom, that hairstyle makes you look old.
zh: 媽媽，妳這個髮型顯得老氣。

en: Travel agencies' profits soared.
zh: 旅行社的利润猛涨。

en: May I pay with a travelers' check?
zh: 我可以用旅行支票支付嗎？

en: The traveler was delighted at the sight of a light in the distance.
zh: 发现了远处的灯光的旅行者欢喜不已。

en: The delegations of both countries met in Geneva.
zh: 两国代表团在日内瓦会面。

en: The heater doesn't work.
zh: 暖氣壞了。

en: There are noticeable differences between the two.
zh: 两者之间有显著的差别。

en: There is no connection between them.
zh: 两者没有关联。

en: My parents sent me a postcard.
zh: 我父母給我寄了一張明信片。

en: My parents have just arrived at the station.
zh: 我的父母剛剛到達車站。

en: The price does not include the box.
zh: 這個價格不包含這個箱子。

en: A cooking course should be mandatory in schools.
zh: 烹饪课程应该作为学校的必修课。

en: Quality is more important than quantity.
zh: 数量不如质量。

en: I'd like a receipt, please.
zh: 麻煩我要一張收據。

en: A green carpet will not go with this blue curtain.
zh: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。

en: My eyes are watering.
zh: 我在流眼淚。

en: The service is excellent in this hotel.
zh: 这家酒店服务很好。

en: Thanks to a cold summer, beer has sold poorly.
zh: 多虧了冷夏，啤酒賣的不好。

en: The Cold War ended when the Soviet Union collapsed.
zh: 冷战以苏联解体结束。

en: As the train came to a halt, all of the passengers wondered what was happening.
zh: 当列车停止时，所有的乘客都想知道发生了什么。

en: We have ample time to catch our train.
zh: 我们有充裕的时间赶上火车。

en: I caught a glimpse of Mt. Fuji from the window of the train.
zh: 我從火車車窗瞥見了富士山。

en: There were several rooms still vacant.
zh: 还有几间空房。

en: Many of the workers died of hunger.
zh: 许多工人死于饥饿。

en: The workers are on strike.
zh: 工人罢工。

en: I'm getting farsighted as I get older.
zh: 當我年長時，我漸漸變得有遠見。

en: It is important for old people to stay strong.
zh: 老人保持强健很重要。

en: Although old, he is still very much alive.
zh: 虽然上了年纪,他依旧充满活力。

en: The old man loaded his mule with bags full of sand.
zh: 老人在骡子的背上放上了一个个装满了沙的袋子。

en: An aging population will require more spending on health care.
zh: 老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。

en: Needless to say, fundamental human rights should be respected.
zh: 無須多言，基本人權應當被尊重。

en: Have you finished writing your thesis?
zh: 你的论文写完了吗？

en: We talked about a variety of topics.
zh: 我們談了各種話題。

en: The planets revolve around the sun.
zh: 行星繞著太陽轉。

en: Tom remained a bachelor until his death.
zh: 汤姆终身未娶。

en: Tom's eyesight is deteriorating.
zh: Tom的视力正在恶化。

en: A good craftsman takes pride in his work.
zh: 好的工匠為自己的作品感到驕傲。

en: Let go of my arm! I can't stand people touching me.
zh: 放開我的手臂！我不能忍受有人碰我。

en: I had an asthma attack.
zh: 我哮喘发作了。

en: I think to clearly distinguish opinion from fact is important.
zh: 我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

en: He doesn't realise that he's tone deaf.
zh: 他不知道他自己五音不全。

en: The Oscar ceremonies are Hollywood's biggest extravaganza.
zh: 奥斯卡颁奖典礼，是好莱坞最盛大的活动。

en: I trust that I can see you again.
zh: 我相信我能再見到你。

en: I hope we'll see each other again sometime.
zh: 我希望我們有時間還可以見面。

en: According to the guidebook, this is the best restaurant around here.
zh: 根據指南，這是這附近最好的餐館。

en: The good thing about this electronic dictionary is that it's easy to carry.
zh: 这电子辞典的好处就是便于携带。

en: You should have shown him the device.
zh: 你应该给他看看这装置。

en: Beer is taxed according to its malt content, so low-malt beer is cheaper.
zh: 因为啤酒会根据麦芽含量去征税，所以发泡酒会比较便宜。

en: Pale ale is a low-alcohol beer.
zh: 淡啤酒是一種酒精含量低的啤酒。

en: I don't want to do anything risky.
zh: 我不想做任何冒險的事。

en: I finally got hold of that book I wanted.
zh: 我最终得到了我要的那本书。

en: The lion is the king of the beasts.
zh: 狮子是万兽之王。

en: Stop putting off finding a job.
zh: 不要拖延去找工作的事。

en: Sleep deprivation increases risk of heart attacks.
zh: 睡眠不足增加心臟病發作的危險。

en: The first thing you have to take into consideration is time.
zh: 你应该考虑的第一件事是时间。

en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
zh: 蜿蜒的小路爬上了陡坡。

en: More and more people are moving to urban areas.
zh: 越來越多的人遷往市區。

en: The princess begged forgiveness from the emperor.
zh: 公主向皇帝请求饶恕。

en: Why are we wasting time with this?
zh: 为什么我们在这上面浪费时间？

en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
zh: 在你有需要的時候，會幫你的朋友才是真正的朋友。

en: You've both been very impressive today. I'm proud of you.
zh: 今天你们俩很让人印象深刻。我为你们感到骄傲。

en: You must be kidding!
zh: 你一定是开玩笑！

en: I lost my father to a subarachnoid haemorrhage when I was fourteen.
zh: 我十四岁的时候，父亲死于蛛网膜下出血。

en: I've been wanting to see that movie for a long time.

en: His observations are sharp, but he doesn't say much.
zh: 他的觀察是敏銳的，但他沒有說太多。

en: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.
zh: 正式工比临时工要好。

en: I think that it could use some salt.
zh: 我认为这可以撒些盐。

en: Say no to drugs.
zh: 對毒品說不。

en: Winners don't use drugs.
zh: 優勝者不使用藥物。

en: Other people's expectations affect how we behave.
zh: 其他人的期望會影響我們的行為。

en: Everything was where it was supposed to be.
zh: 所有的物件都在原處。

en: The tsunami alert was cancelled.
zh: 海啸的警报解除了。

en: I was asked whether I wanted to do that.
zh: 我被问到我是不是要这么做。

en: What color is barium?
zh: 鋇是什麼顏色的？

en: I'm content with my job.
zh: 我對我的工作感到滿意。

en: I just ate sushi and drank beer.
zh: 我剛才吃了壽司喝了啤酒。

en: You're liable for the debt.
zh: 你有义务还债。

en: You're apt to be forgetful.
zh: 你很健忘。

en: Tom drank the entire bottle of wine by himself.
zh: 汤姆独自喝了一整瓶酒。

en: Tom was wearing a yellow shirt with a blue tie.
zh: 湯姆穿著一件黃色襯衫，繫著一條藍色領帶。

en: Do you really think that I look like Tom?
zh: 你真的觉得我长得像汤姆吗？

en: He does well in physics.
zh: 他的物理学得很好。

en: I'd be thrilled to do that.
zh: 我很乐意这么做。

en: Tom is wearing a purple sweatshirt.
zh: 湯姆穿著一件紫色的運動衫。

en: Tom is afraid that somebody will see him.
zh: 湯姆怕有人看到他。

en: Tom will be the first person to enter the cave.
zh: 汤姆将会是第一个进入那洞穴的人。

en: Is that a stork or a heron?
zh: 那是一只鹳还是一只苍鹭？

en: He put his hand gently on her shoulder.
zh: 他把他的手溫柔地放在她的肩上。

en: Grandma likes watching TV.
zh: 祖母非常喜欢看电视。

en: He explained the literal meaning of the sentence.
zh: 他解释了句子的字面意思。

en: He likes to go out on horseback.
zh: 他喜欢骑马出行。

en: Can you do bookkeeping?
zh: 你會記帳嗎?

en: Have you drained the bathtub?
zh: 你把浴缸裡的水放掉了嗎？

en: About how long does it take to fill the bathtub?
zh: 注滿浴缸大約需要多久時間？

en: What's the difference between astronomy and astrology?
zh: 「astronomy」和「astrology」有什麼區別？

en: Why do people commit suicide?
zh: 为什么人们会自杀?

en: Ignore Tom and me.
zh: 无视汤姆和我。

en: Many people are suffering from hunger around the world.
zh: 世界上许多人在挨饿。

en: There were only three passengers on the bus when it exploded.
zh: 当汽车爆炸时，车上只有三名乘客。

en: I donate blood every three months.
zh: 我每三个月献一次血。

en: If you don't leave, I'll sic my dogs on you.
zh: 如果你不离开，我就放狗出来咬你。

en: One of your tires is flat.
zh: 你的轮胎爆了一个。

en: There was nothing I could do at that time.
zh: 当时我什么都不能做。

en: I don't believe Tom's version of the story.
zh: 我不相信汤姆的说法。

en: The cargo ship arrived four hours early.
zh: 货船早到了四小时。

en: Not all red apples taste the same.
zh: 不是所有的紅蘋果吃起來味道都一樣。

en: Where's the volume control?
zh: 音量調節在哪裡？

en: I heard Tom muttering something in French.
zh: 我听到汤姆在用法语嘀咕些什么。

en: He acted like a lunatic.
zh: 他表现的像个疯子。

en: Mary was wearing a navy blue skirt.
zh: 玛丽穿着深蓝色的裙子。

en: Please peel the potatoes.
zh: 請把馬鈴薯的皮削掉。

en: The bodyguard was wearing an earpiece.
zh: 保镖戴着耳机。

en: I grow tomatoes and onions in my garden.
zh: 我在花园种了番茄和洋葱。

en: This is a crucial point.
zh: 这是一个关键点。

en: I just wanted to prove to myself that I could do this.
zh: 我只想向自己证明我可以做到。

en: Tom dragged himself out of bed and put on his clothes.
zh: 汤姆从床上爬起来，穿上了衣服。

en: I was quite thirsty and wanted to drink something cool.
zh: 我很渴，想喝点冷饮。

en: Ebola is one of the most virulent viruses known to man.
zh: 埃博拉是人类已知的最致命的病毒之一。

en: I hope that Tom has learned his lesson.
zh: 我希望汤姆已经吸取教训了。

en: Tom has just remodeled his kitchen.
zh: 汤姆刚改建了他的厨房。

en: Tom found a skeleton in the cave.
zh: 汤姆在洞穴里找到了一具骨架。

en: When Tom found out about that, he was furious.
zh: 当汤姆发现这件事时，他很生气。

en: Tom advised me not to buy a secondhand car.
zh: 汤姆建议我不要买二手车。

en: The main question is how does Tom feel.
zh: 主要的问题是汤姆的感受如何。

en: It wouldn't be wise to ignore Tom completely.
zh: 完全忽视汤姆不会是明智的。

en: Tom is our starting quarterback.
zh: 汤姆是我们的首发四分卫。

en: Wipe the pan dry with a paper towel.
zh: 用纸巾把平底锅擦干。

en: Tom has started studying karate.
zh: 汤姆已经开始学习空手道了。

en: This is only one of the things we found.
zh: 这只是我们发现的东西之一。

en: Doing that is simply out of the question.
zh: 根本不可能做那件事。

en: Tom hid in the shed.
zh: 汤姆躲在棚里。

en: Are you afraid of being fired?
zh: 你害怕被炒鱿鱼吗？

en: Tom paid me back the money he owed me.
zh: 汤姆把欠我的钱还给我了。

en: We want to spend our honeymoon in Australia.
zh: 我们想在澳大利亚过蜜月。

en: Tom doesn't even know how to fry an egg.
zh: 汤姆甚至连怎么煎鸡蛋都不知道。

en: I have nowhere to go now.
zh: 我现在无处可去。

en: Do you have a fever and a sore throat?
zh: 你發燒和喉嚨痛嗎?

en: My aunt made a new skirt for me.
zh: 我姑姑做了一條新裙子給我。

en: We have to have fun somehow.
zh: 我们总得找点乐子。

en: If I were invisible I wouldn't have to dress myself.
zh: 若我是隱形的，就不用穿衣服了。

en: I'm not picky. I'll eat anything.
zh: 我不挑剔，我什么都吃。

en: Can I borrow your book for a minute?
zh: 我可以借一会你的书吗？

en: Tom baked some chocolate chip cookies.
zh: 汤姆烤了些巧克力脆饼。

en: Do you have tinnitus?
zh: 你耳鸣吗？

en: Please conduct yourself with dignity.
zh: 请自重。

en: That really whets my appetite.
zh: 那很開胃。

en: Who has the edge now?
zh: 目前谁占上风？

en: The road is very treacherous.
zh: 这条路挺险恶。

en: I never drink tea with lemon.
zh: 我從來不喝檸檬茶。

en: He interrupted our conversation.
zh: 他打断了我们的谈论。

en: Cats hate vacuum cleaners.
zh: 猫很讨厌吸尘器。

en: I hung the calendar on the wall.
zh: 我把日曆掛在牆上。

en: My brother is a professor.
zh: 我哥哥是教授。

en: I like to eat honey and peanut butter sandwiches.
zh: 我喜歡吃蜂蜜花生醬三明治。

en: The lion is stalking its prey.
zh: 狮子在跟踪它的猎物。

en: Do you want to eat garbanzo beans?
zh: 你想吃鹰嘴豆吗？

en: You need to shed some pounds.
zh: 你需要甩掉几磅。

en: Is that a coyote?
zh: 那是丛林狼吗？

en: He asked her seven times to marry him.
zh: 他向她求婚求了七次。

en: My home is separated from his by a river.
zh: 我的家与他的隔着一条江。

en: They are separated by a great distance.
zh: 他们之间隔着很远的距离。

en: I bought a book online.
zh: 我在網上買了一本書。

en: Tom doesn't like women who wear too much makeup.
zh: 汤姆不喜欢妆化太浓的女人。

en: Slavery is a crime against humanity.
zh: 奴役制是一种危害人类罪。

en: Is there a bus stop nearby?
zh: 這附近有公交站嗎？

en: May I have a glass of milk, please?
zh: 请问能给我一杯牛奶吗？

en: There's a crown here.
zh: 这里有个皇冠。

en: When the phone rang, he ran to answer it.
zh: 電話響起時，他跑去接起。

en: Why don't you eat pineapple?
zh: 你為什麼不吃菠蘿？

en: Lonely people tend to be afraid of meeting others, which ensures they will always be lonely.
zh: 孤獨的人會孤獨，是因為他畏懼他人。

en: She forced him to eat spinach.
zh: 她強迫他吃菠菜。

en: She kissed him on the cheek.
zh: 她亲吻他的脸颊。

en: She knit him a sweater.
zh: 她给他织了件毛衣。

en: She often takes advantage of his ignorance.
zh: 她常常利用他的无知。

en: She pulled him out of the mud.
zh: 她把他从烂泥中拽出来了。

en: She stabbed him in the back.
zh: 她在他的背上戳了一下。

en: She told him that she believed in astrology.
zh: 她告诉了他自己相信占星术。

en: She tried to persuade him to attend the meeting.
zh: 她试图说服他来参加会议。

en: She wants to hug him.
zh: 她想擁抱他。

en: How do I get to the beach from here?
zh: 从这里到海滩该怎么走？

en: This really is a masterpiece.
zh: 这真是个杰作。

en: Staying up late at night is very bad for your skin.
zh: 熬夜是皮肤的大敌。

en: I eventually got used to it.
zh: 最后我还是习惯了。

en: Hot weather will continue, so please watch out for food poisoning.
zh: 因为酷暑一直持续着，请务必注意食物中毒。

en: A liar needs to have a good memory.
zh: 说谎的人需要很好的记忆力。

en: Mom is preparing a meal in the kitchen.
zh: 媽媽正在廚房裡做飯。

en: When it's windy, the leaves of the old oak rustle and its branches creak.
zh: 刮風的時候，老橡樹的葉子會沙沙作響，樹枝會發出嘎吱聲。

en: I hope I can do that before I die.
zh: 我希望我能在死前做到。

en: The baby was sleeping soundly in his mother's arms.
zh: 孩子在母亲的怀中熟睡。

en: Every time he comes here, he orders the same dish.
zh: 每次他来这里点一样的菜。

en: The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy brown dog.
zh: 身手矯健的棕狐狸躍過懶洋洋的棕狗。

en: They have a very nice veranda.
zh: 他们有一个非常漂亮的暖房。

en: The price of rice has fallen.
zh: 米价下跌了。

en: Divide the pizza in three.
zh: 把披薩分成三份。

en: Three cubed is twenty-seven.
zh: 三的立方是二十七。

en: I nearly left my umbrella on the train.
zh: 我幾乎把我的雨傘忘在火車上。

en: You're the master of your own destiny.
zh: 你才是自己命运的主人。

en: I have never fed my dog a banana.
zh: 我從沒給我的狗喂過香蕉。

en: If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.
zh: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。

en: He behaved like a madman.
zh: 他表现的像个疯子。

en: Strawberries sell for a high price in the winter.
zh: 草莓在冬天售價高。

en: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.
zh: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。

en: We woke up very early in order to see the sunrise.
zh: 我们起得很早为了看到日出。

en: Tom was drinking coffee from a thermos bottle.
zh: 湯姆正在用保溫瓶喝咖啡。

en: This quilt is very warm.
zh: 這條被子很暖和。

en: To my surprise, he was good at singing.
zh: 让我出乎意料的是，他居然很会唱歌。

en: No one noticed her absence until the meeting ended.
zh: 直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。

en: There is an urgent need for medical supplies.
zh: 急需醫療用品。

en: What's your favorite beverage?
zh: 你最喜欢的饮料是什么？

en: What's your favorite item of clothing?
zh: 你最喜欢哪类的衣服？

en: What's your favorite nursery rhyme?
zh: 你最喜歡的兒童歌曲是哪首？

en: What's your favorite way to cook beans?
zh: 你最喜歡用什麼方法煮豆子？

en: What's your favorite way to cook trout?
zh: 你最喜欢怎么烧鲑鱼?

en: Let me have a look at your notebook.
zh: 請給我看一下你的筆記本電腦。

en: What's your favorite operating system?
zh: 你最喜欢的操作系统是哪个？

en: You need to be aggressive.
zh: 你需要更有进取心。

en: Who's your favorite character in this book?
zh: 你最喜歡這本書中的哪個角色？

en: Do you have a fountain pen?
zh: 你有鋼筆嗎？

en: I don't like to use liquid laundry detergent.
zh: 我不喜歡用洗衣液。

en: It is highly improper.
zh: 这实在不合适。

en: How do you spell your last name?
zh: 你的姓怎麼拼？

en: They set fire to their neighbor's house in revenge.
zh: 為了報仇，他們放火燒了鄰居的家。

en: There aren't many books on these shelves.
zh: 这些书架上没有很多书。

en: I may give up soon and just take a nap.
zh: 也许我会马上放弃然后去打盹。

en: All you have to do is ask him to pay the debt.
zh: 你只需要喊他还债就行。

en: This stuff is worth its weight in gold!
zh: 這個東西很有價值。

en: Your suggestion is worth considering.
zh: 你的建议值得考虑。

en: My wallet is made of leather.
zh: 我的钱包是皮制的。

en: Your knife is rusty.
zh: 你的刀生鏽了。

en: Fashion is not my specialty.
zh: 时装不是我的天分。

en: My mother made us cheese sandwiches for lunch.
zh: 媽媽為我們做了乳酪三明治當午餐。

en: Mary works as a cashier.
zh: 玛丽是个收银员。

en: He had a smile on his face.
zh: 他面帶笑容。

en: The universe is limitless.
zh: 宇宙浩瀚無邊。

en: Tom told me that Mary is his type.
zh: 汤姆和我说玛丽是他喜欢的类型。

en: The average height of girls in this class is over 155 centimeters.
zh: 这个班的女生平均身高超过了155公分。

en: She looks young, but in reality she's over 40.
zh: 她看起来是年轻的，但实际上她四十多岁了。

en: My knife has become dull.
zh: 我的刀變鈍了。

en: Germany was once an ally of Italy.
zh: 德国曾是意大利的同盟国。

en: Last night I had a weird dream.
zh: 我昨晚做了一個奇怪的夢。

en: He always gets bullied at school.
zh: 他在學校老是被人欺負。

en: I keep the master copy under lock and key.
zh: 我妥善保管原版拷貝。

en: One of the hawk's wings is broken.
zh: 鷹的一隻翅膀斷了。

en: Tom will graduate from high school the year after next.
zh: 湯姆將在後年高中畢業。

en: Mary is an exceptionally beautiful girl.
zh: 瑪麗是一個非常漂亮的姑娘。

en: Tom is an opera fan.
zh: 湯姆是歌劇愛好者。

en: Someone is waiting for you downstairs.
zh: 楼下有人在等您。

en: Except for the bad weather and the frequent earthquakes, this is almost a perfect place to live.
zh: 這裡除了惡劣的天氣和頻繁的地震之外，幾乎就是一個完美的居住地。

en: Can I have a piece of this apple pie?
zh: 我可以吃一塊蘋果派嗎？

en: Do you have your student identification card?
zh: 你有學生證嗎？

en: I want to introduce you to my friend here.
zh: 我想給你介紹一下我身旁這位朋友。

en: I have a bit of a headache today.
zh: 有今天有點頭疼。

en: I was hot, so I switched on the fan.
zh: 我很熱，就把電風扇打開了。

en: I just remembered something.
zh: 我突然想到一件事。

en: Do you know what sadness feels like?
zh: 你知道悲伤的滋味么？

en: Beef is usually more expensive than pork.
zh: 牛肉通常比豬肉貴。

en: I have to go home a little early today.
zh: 我今天要早点回家。

en: They're typical young people.
zh: 他们是典型的年轻人。

en: What color is your belt?
zh: 你的腰帶是什麼顏色？

en: Tom hates the smell of herring.
zh: 汤姆讨厌鲱鱼味。

en: Soda makes Tom jittery.
zh: 蘇打水讓湯姆感到緊張。

en: No security system is foolproof.
zh: 沒有防傻的安全系統。

en: It'll be windy tomorrow.
zh: 明天會有風。

en: I didn't mean to discourage you.
zh: 我不想打擊你的。

en: My mom and I are completely different.
zh: 我媽媽和我完全不同。

en: I hate terrorist organizations.
zh: 我痛恨恐怖主义组织。

en: Tom stuck a fork in my arm.
zh: 湯姆用叉子戳我的手臂。

en: Kale is considered a superfood.
zh: 羽衣甘藍被認為是超級食物。

en: You should bring your passport to the bank.
zh: 你应该带护照去银行。

en: How many times a minute does the average person blink?
zh: 人平均一分钟眨几次眼睛？

en: Look in the rear-view mirror before backing up.
zh: 倒車前先看後視鏡。

en: Are you closer to your mother or to your father?
zh: 你和爸爸更亲还是妈妈更亲？

en: Are you sure that you want to go there?
zh: 你确定你要去那儿吗？

en: Biting your fingernails is a bad habit.
zh: 咬指甲是个坏习惯。

en: Have you ever dyed your hair?
zh: 你染過頭髮嗎？

en: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone knows me.
zh: 我知道有人认识我的可能性微乎其微。

en: I shouldn't have eaten the whole bag of potato chips.
zh: 我不该把一整包薯片都吃完的。

en: I studied English for four years with a native speaker.
zh: 我跟英语母语者学了四年英语。

en: I think skateboards are usually cheaper than rollerblades.
zh: 我觉得一般滑板比轮滑鞋便宜。

en: I think the time is right to introduce this product.
zh: 我覺得現在是發表這個產品的好時機。

en: I wish I could figure out how to delete my Facebook account.
zh: 我希望我能知道如何刪除我的Facebook帳號。

en: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
zh: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。

en: I've been requested to help you.
zh: 有人请我帮你。

en: In the end, we ended up eating at that shabby restaurant.
zh: 结果，我们在那破破烂烂的餐馆里吃了饭。

en: Is eating cockroaches a bad idea?
zh: 吃蟑螂不好嗎？

en: My son never eats his spinach.
zh: 我兒子從來不吃菠菜。

en: The coral reef is the region's prime attraction.
zh: 珊瑚礁是这个地区的主要景点。

en: Would you like to know how to prevent getting wrinkles?
zh: 你想要知道如何避免皺紋嗎？

en: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.
zh: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。

en: I'm still a beginner.
zh: 我还是个新手。

en: They're plotting to kill the king.
zh: 他們正密謀要殺害國王。

en: This last song is one I wrote for my wife.
zh: 最后一首歌是我为妻子写的一首。

en: What kind of movie do you want to watch?
zh: 你想看哪种类型的电影？

en: I majored in philosophy in college.
zh: 我在大學主修哲學。

en: The file is corrupt.
zh: 文件已损坏。

en: My son is being toilet trained.
zh: 我兒子正在鍛鍊上廁所。

en: My son is being potty trained.
zh: 我兒子正在鍛鍊上廁所。

en: Mix the ingredients well.
zh: 把配料好好混一下。

en: Cut the meat into strips.
zh: 將肉切成條狀。

en: Tom isn't eating a peach. He's eating a plum.
zh: 湯姆沒有吃桃子，他在吃李子。

en: Burn this letter after you finish reading it.
zh: 看完这封信请把它烧掉。

en: You're no longer a mere child.
zh: 你不再只是一个孩子了。

en: That house is the place where I was born.
zh: 那房子是我出生的地方。
